tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search plain-English guides on appealing UK parking tickets: council PCNs, private parking charges (ParkingEye, Euro Car Parks, APCOA...), bus lane, ULEZ, Clean Air Zone, Notice to Owner, TE9 witness statements, London boroughs and contravention codes. Returns slugs to pass to get_guide.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns a full AppealGo guide as Markdown, with its sources.

tools.name: explain_contravention_code
tools.description: What a two-digit council PCN contravention code means (e.g. 01, 12, 30, 34, 62), its penalty band, and the grounds that usually beat it.

tools.name: search_contravention_codes
tools.description: Find the code for a description, e.g. 'disabled bay' or 'bus lane'.

tools.name: calculate_deadlines
tools.description: Given the notice type and the date on the notice, returns the discount deadline, the challenge/representations deadline, when escalation can start, and (if you pass a rejection date) the tribunal or POPLA/IAS deadline. Statutory defaults; the notice is authoritative.

tools.name: lookup_appeal_status
tools.description: Public status for a customer reference such as PCN-4471A2B9.
